MODES.road: convoys of tokens; isolation is derived from road segments

ROUTES.name: Gateway-Summit road
ROUTES.narrativeCut: Gateway-Summit road: debris, then water. Gateway's people reach the city or do not.
ROUTES.narrativeReopen: The ring road is mostly open again.

ROUTES.name: The river bridges
ROUTES.narrativeCut: The river bridges are under water.

ROUTES.name: Sterling-Haven road
ROUTES.narrativeCut: Sterling-Haven road under surge. Each parish is on its own road.

ROUTES.name: Haven-Keystone road (the surge creek)
ROUTES.narrativeCut: The Haven-Keystone road floods at the surge creek. Keystone is cut from the port.
ROUTES.narrativeReopen: The surge creek crossing is open.

ROUTES.name: Keystone-Gateway road
ROUTES.narrativeCut: Keystone-Gateway road closed by water and debris.

ROUTES.name: The Gorge Road
ROUTES.narrativeCut: The Gorge Road floods. Heartland is alone; tankers that have not climbed will not.

ROUTES.name: The South Switchbacks
ROUTES.narrativeCut: The South Switchbacks slide. Caldera village and the works are cut from Keystone.

ROUTES.name: The runway (fixed-wing to the mainland)
ROUTES.narrativeCut: The last commercial flight has left. The runway closes at 45 mph.
ROUTES.narrativeReopen: One lane of the runway cleared, medevac capable.

ROUTES.name: Helicopter: Sterling to the hospital and the mainland
ROUTES.narrativeCut: The helicopters cannot fly above 40 mph sustained.

ROUTES.name: Helicopter: Sterling to the sea south of the Mole
By sea round the south-west point
ROUTES.narrativeCut: The sea south of the Mole is no place for a boat.
ROUTES.narrativeReopen: Boats can round the south-west point.

ROUTES.name: On foot by the surge creek bridge
ROUTES.narrativeCut: The surge creek bridge is under water.
ROUTES.narrativeReopen: The surge creek bridge is passable.

ISOLATION: a parish is isolated when no road segment touching it is open
